patthana15.24:1.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetusampayutto na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana15.24:2.1: hetusampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetusampayutto na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.24:3.1: hetuvippayuttaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetuvippayutto na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ. hetu ceva sahetuko kusalo dhammo na hetussa ceva na ahetukassa na kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo, ekaṃ.
